title: Time limit for President's opinion
description: The President or other member has a time limit to give opinion on referred points

content.general_rule: The President or other member shall give opinion on the point or points so referred
content.exception: Provided that the opinion shall be given within a period of two months from the date of such reference
conditions: within a period of two months from the date of such reference
